title: Elasticsearch安装步骤
content:
Elasticsearch安装

下载安装公钥签名sudo rpm --import https://artifacts.elastic.co/GPG-KEY-elasticsearch

从rpm REPO 安装(后续更新可用)sudo bash -c 'cat >> /etc/yum.repos.d/elasticsearch.repo << EOF[elasticsearch]name=Elasticsearch repository for 7.x packagesbaseurl=https://artifacts.elastic.co/packages/7.x/yumgpgcheck=1gpgkey=https://artifacts.elastic.co/GPG-KEY-elasticsearchenabled=1autorefresh=1type=rpm-mdEOF'

使用rpm包手动安装，指定版本
# 下载rpm包wget https://artifacts.elastic.co/downloads/elasticsearch/elasticsearch-7.17.13-x86_64.rpm# 下载校验文件wget https://artifacts.elastic.co/downloads/elasticsearch/elasticsearch-7.17.13-x86_64.rpm.sha512# 校验完整性sha512sum -c elasticsearch-7.17.13-x86_64.rpm.sha512# 安装 sudo rpm --install elasticsearch-7.17.13-x86_64.rpm

修改配置文件sudo vim /etc/elasticsearch/elasticsearch.yml

cluster.name: erp-zhnode.name: node-xpath.data: /opt/data/elasticsearch/datapath.log: /opt/data/elasticsearch/lognetwork.host: 0.0.0.0http.port: 9200discovery.seed_hosts: ["node-1.ip","node-2.ip","node-3.ip"]cluster.initial_master_nodes: ["node-1","node-2","node-3"]

初始化目录sudo mkdir -p /opt/data/elasticsearch/datasudo mkdir -p /opt/data/elasticsearch/datasudo chown -R elasticsearch:elasticsearch /opt/data/elasticsearch

设置keyStore密码（非必须）sudo bash -c 'echo "password" > /opt/data/elasticsearch/pwd_file.tmp'sudo chmod 600 /opt/data/elasticsearch/pwd_file.tmpsudo chown elasticsearch:elasticsearch /opt/data/elasticsearch/pwd_file.tmpsudo systemctl set-environment ES_KEYSTORE_PASSPHRASE_FILE=/opt/data/elasticsearch/pwd_file.tmp

启动并设置开机启动sudo systemctl daemon-reloadsudo systemctl enable elasticsearchsudo systemctl start elasticsearch

配置sslsudo /usr/share/elasticsearch/bin/elasticsearch-certutil casudo /usr/share/elasticsearch/bin/elasticsearch-certutil cert --ca elastic-stack-ca.p12sudo cp /usr/share/elasticsearch/elastic-certificates.p12 /etc/elasticsearch/## 编辑配置sudo vim /etc/elasticsearch/elasticsearch.ymlxpack.security.enabled: truexpack.security.transport.ssl.enabled: truexpack.security.transport.ssl.verification_mode: certificatexpack.security.transport.ssl.client_authentication: requiredxpack.security.transport.ssl.keystore.path: elastic-certificates.p12xpack.security.transport.ssl.truststore.path: elastic-certificates.p12# 重新启动sudo systemctl restart elasticsearch

手动设置密码sudo /usr/share/elasticsearch/bin/elasticsearch-setup-passwords interactive

title: MySQL安装步骤
content:
mysql安装

下载 Mysql Yum repositorywget https://dev.mysql.com/get/mysql84-community-release-el7-1.noarch.rpm

安装sudo rpm -ivh mysql84-community-release-el7-1.noarch.rpm

禁用mysql仓库sudo yum-config-manager --disable mysql57-communitysudo yum-config-manager --disable mysql56-communitysudo yum-config-manager --disable mysql55-communitysudo yum-config-manager --disable mysql80-communitysudo yum-config-manager --disable mysql84-community

创建自定义yum 仓库文件sudo vim /etc/yum.repos.d/mysql-community.repo[mysql-8.0.36]name=MySQL 8.0.36 Community Serverbaseurl=https://repo.mysql.com/yum/mysql-8.0-community/el/7/x86_64/enabled=1gpgcheck=1gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-mysql

清理缓存并安装mysql8.0.36sudo yum clean allsudo yum install mysql-community-server-8.0.36

编辑配置文件sudo vim /etc/my.cnf# 根据实际业务与机器配置修改

启动mysqlmkdir -p /opt/data/mysqldatamkdir -p /opt/data/mysqllog/errormkdir -p /opt/data/mysqllog/generalmkdir -p /opt/data/mysqllog/slow-querytouch /opt/data/mysqllog/error/mysqld.logtouch /opt/data/mysqllog/general/mysql-general.logtouch /opt/data/mysqllog/slow-query/mysql-slow.sqlsudo chown -R mysql:mysql /opt/data/mysqllog /opt/data/mysqldatasudo systemctl start mysqldsudo systemctl enable mysqld

获取mysql 密码sudo grep 'temporary password' /opt/data/mysqllog/error/mysqld.log

修改临时密码ALTER USER 'root'@'localhost' identified by 'xxx';#授权grant all privileges on *.* to 'user'@'host';

运行安全脚本sudo mysql_secure_installation

title: SpringBoot 源码阅读计划
content:
Spring Boot 源码阅读计划周数	目标主题	具体安排


第1周入门与整体启动流程	Day 1：了解 Spring Boot 核心特点，搭建最小应用，了解 @SpringBootApplicationDay 2：阅读 SpringApplication 类，重点关注 run() 方法Day 3：理解 ApplicationContext 创建流程（createApplicationContext()）Day 4：学习 ApplicationListener 和事件机制（如 ApplicationStartingEvent）Day 5：调试启动过程，串起完整时序图Day 6-7：总结一周内容，画一张大启动流程图（推荐用 draw.io）
第2周自动配置与条件装配机制	Day 8：阅读 @EnableAutoConfiguration、@SpringBootConfigurationDay 9：学习 AutoConfigurationImportSelector 机制Day 10：阅读 spring.factories 加载逻辑，理解 SPI 机制Day 11：了解 @ConditionalXXX 注解体系Day 12：实际跟一个自动配置例子（如 WebMvcAutoConfiguration）Day 13-14：练习：自己写一个简单的自动配置模块
第3周配置绑定与扩展机制	Day 15：阅读 @ConfigurationProperties，了解属性绑定Day 16：学习 Binder 的实现原理Day 17：探索 EnvironmentPostProcessor（如何动态修改配置）Day 18：学习 ApplicationContextInitializer 的扩展点Day 19：阅读 ApplicationRunner / CommandLineRunner 的扩展用法Day 20-21：动手实现：自定义配置类、初步 Starter 模块
第4周Web服务启动、Actuator和总结	Day 22：阅读 ServletWebServerFactoryAutoConfiguration，了解内嵌 Tomcat/Jetty 启动流程Day 23：调试 TomcatServletWebServerFactory，理解创建 Embedded Servlet Container 逻辑Day 24：初探 Actuator：阅读 HealthEndpoint 自动配置Day 25：了解错误处理机制（ErrorMvcAutoConfiguration）Day 26：扩展阅读：日志系统整合（Logback、Log4j2）机制Day 27-28：动手扩展一个简单的自定义 EndpointDay 29：整理整个阅读笔记，形成一份小总结文档Day 30：复盘整体阅读经验，思考可以深入哪些方向（如与 Spring Cloud 集成）
